title: अष्टात्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The darkness deepens until the soldiers cannot tell friend from foe, and Duryodhana tells them to light lamps. Drona blazes like a great fire among the Pandavas as torches light the field.
summary.kn: ಕತ್ತಲು ಗಾಢವಾಗಿ ಸೈನಿಕರಿಗೆ ಮಿತ್ರ-ಶತ್ರು ತಿಳಿಯದಾಗ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ದೀಪ ಹಚ್ಚಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಂಜುಗಳು ರಣರಂಗವನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ದ್ರೋಣ ಪಾಂಡವರ ನಡುವೆ ಮಹಾಗ್ನಿಯಂತೆ ಉರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अँधेरा इतना गहरा हो जाता है कि सैनिक मित्र-शत्रु नहीं पहचान पाते, तब दुर्योधन दीपक जलाने को कहता है। मशालों से रणभूमि जगमगाने पर द्रोण पाण्डवों के बीच महा-अग्नि की तरह जलते हैं।
summary.te: చీకటి ఎంత దట్టమవుతుందంటే సైనికులు మిత్రశత్రువులను గుర్తించలేరు; దుర్యోధనుడు దీపాలు వెలిగించమంటాడు. కాగడాలు రణభూమిని వెలిగించగా ద్రోణుడు పాండవుల మధ్య మహాగ్నిలా మండుతాడు.
summary.ta: இருள் அடர்ந்து வீரர் நண்பர் பகைவரை அறியாமல் போக, துரியோதனன் விளக்கேற்றும்படி கூறுகிறான். தீவட்டிகள் களத்தை ஒளிர்விக்க, த்ரோணர் பாண்டவரிடையே பெருந்தீ போல் எரிகிறார்.
summary.ml: ഇരുട്ട് കൂടുന്നതിനാൽ സൈനികർക്ക് സ്വന്തക്കാരെയും ശത്രുക്കളെയും തിരിച്ചറിയാനാകാത്ത അവസ്ഥയാകുന്നു; ദുര്യോധനൻ വിളക്കുകൾ കത്തിക്കാൻ കൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു. പന്തങ്ങൾ രംഗം പ്രകാശിപ്പിക്കുമ്പോൾ ദ്രോണർ പാണ്ഡവർക്കിടയിൽ മഹാഗ്നിപോലെ ജ്വലിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.138; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
वर्तमाने तथा युद्धे घोररूपे भयावहे ।
तमसा संवृते लोके रजसा च महीपते ।
नापश्यन्त रणे योधाः परस्परमवस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: As that terrible and fearful battle went on, with the world wrapped in darkness and dust, O king, the warriors standing in the fight could not see one another.

verses.text:
अनुमानेन संज्ञाभिर्युद्धं तद्ववृते महत् ।
नरनागाश्वमथनं परमं लोमहर्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: That great battle went on by guesswork and by signs, a crushing of men, elephants and horses, most hair-raising.

verses.text:
द्रोणकर्णकृपा वीरा भीमपार्षतसात्यकाः ।
अन्योन्यं क्षोभयामासुः सैन्यानि नृपसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: The heroes Drona, Karna and Kripa, and Bhima, Prishata's son and Satyaki, threw each other's armies into turmoil, best of kings.

verses.text:
वध्यमानानि सैन्यानि समन्तात्तैर्महारथैः ।
तमसा रजसा चैव समन्ताद्विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Struck down on every side by those great warriors, the armies fled in all directions in the darkness and dust.

verses.text:
ते सर्वतो विद्रवन्तो योधा वित्रस्तचेतसः ।
अहन्यन्त महाराज धावमानाश्च संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Those warriors, fleeing everywhere with terrified hearts, were killed, great king, even as they ran in the battle.

verses.text:
महारथसहस्राणि जघ्नुरन्योन्यमाहवे ।
अन्धे तमसि मूढानि पुत्रस्य तव मन्त्रिते ॥

meaning.en: Thousands of great warriors killed one another in the battle, bewildered in the blind darkness, through your son's counsel.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि सेनागोपाश्च भारत ।
व्यमुह्यन्त रणे तत्र तमसा संवृते सति ॥

meaning.en: Then all the armies and their commanders, Bharata, were confused in that battle, shrouded in darkness.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
तेषां संलोड्यमानानां पाण्डवैर्निहतौजसाम् ।
अन्धे तमसि मग्नानामासीत्का वो मतिस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Stirred up by the Pandavas, their spirit broken, sunk in blind darkness, what did you all think then?

verses.text:
कथं प्रकाशस्तेषां वा मम सैन्येषु वा पुनः ।
बभूव लोके तमसा तथा संजय संवृते ॥

meaning.en: How did light come to them, or to my armies, Sanjaya, when the world was covered in darkness?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि हतशिष्टानि यानि वै ।
सेनागोप्तॄनथादिश्य पुनर्व्यूहमकल्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, instructing the commanders, re-formed the array of all the armies, whatever was left after the slaughter.

verses.text:
द्रोणः पुरस्ताज्जघने तु शल्य-
स्तथा द्रौणिः पार्श्वतः सौबलश्च ।
स्वयं तु सर्वाणि बलानि राज-
न्राजाभ्ययाद्गोपयन्वै निशायाम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona was in front, Shalya at the rear, Drona's son and Shakuni's son at the sides; and the king himself went about guarding all the forces that night, O king.

verses.text:
उवाच सर्वांश्च पदातिसंघा-
न्दुर्योधनः पार्थिव सान्त्वपूर्वम् ।
उत्सृज्य सर्वे परमायुधानि
गृह्णीत हस्तैर्ज्वलितान्प्रदीपान् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana spoke to all the bands of foot soldiers with soothing words, O king: "All of you, put down your best weapons and take blazing torches in your hands."

verses.text:
ते चोदिताः पार्थिवसत्तमेन
ततः प्रहृष्टा जगृहुः प्रदीपान् ।
सा भूय एव ध्वजिनी विभक्ता
व्यरोचताग्निप्रभया निशायाम् ॥

meaning.en: Urged on by that best of kings, they happily took up torches; and the army, divided again, shone in the night with the glow of fire.

verses.text:
महाधनैराभरणैश्च दिव्यैः
शस्त्रैः प्रदीप्तैरभिसंपतद्भिः ।
क्षणेन सर्वे विहिताः प्रदीपा
व्यदीपयंश्च ध्वजिनीं तदाशु ॥

meaning.en: With costly ornaments, divine weapons gleaming and rushing about, in a moment all the torches were prepared and quickly lit the army.

verses.text:
सर्वास्तु सेना व्यतिसेव्यमानाः
पदातिभिः पावकतैलहस्तैः ।
प्रकाश्यमाना ददृशुर्निशायां
यथान्तरिक्षे जलदास्तडिद्भिः ॥

meaning.en: All the forces, attended by foot soldiers with fire and oil in their hands, were lit up and seen in the night like clouds with lightning in the sky.

verses.text:
प्रकाशितायां तु तथा ध्वजिन्यां
द्रोणोऽग्निकल्पः प्रतपन्समन्तात् ।
रराज राजेन्द्र सुवर्णवर्मा
मध्यं गतः सूर्य इवांशुमाली ॥

meaning.en: With the army lit up, Drona, like fire, blazing on all sides, shone, O king of kings, in his golden armor like the rayed sun at midday.

verses.text:
जाम्बूनदेष्वाभरणेषु चैव
निष्केषु शुद्धेषु शरावरेषु ।
पीतेषु शस्त्रेषु च पावकस्य
प्रतिप्रभास्तत्र ततो बभूवुः ॥

meaning.en: On golden ornaments, on pure necklaces and helmets, and on weapons dipped in fire-color, reflected glows appeared.

verses.text:
गदाश्च शैक्याः परिघाश्च शुभ्रा
रथेषु शक्त्यश्च विवर्तमानाः ।
प्रतिप्रभा रश्मिभिराजमीढ
पुनः पुनः संजनयन्ति दीप्ताः ॥

meaning.en: Maces, slings, bright iron clubs, and spears rolling in the chariots, O descendant of Ajamidha, shone back again and again with their rays.

verses.text:
छत्राणि बालव्यजनानुषङ्गा
दीप्ता महोल्काश्च तथैव राजन् ।
व्याघूर्णमानाश्च सुवर्णमाला
व्यायच्छतां तत्र तदा विरेजुः ॥

meaning.en: Umbrellas, yak-tail fans and attachments, blazing large firebrands, and swaying golden garlands shone there as they were moved about.

verses.text:
शस्त्रप्रभाभिश्च विराजमानं
दीपप्रभाभिश्च तदा बलं तत् ।
प्रकाशितं चाभरणप्रभाभि-
र्भृशं प्रकाशं नृपते बभूव ॥

meaning.en: That army, shining with the glow of weapons, torches and ornaments, became brilliantly lit, O king.

verses.text:
पीतानि शस्त्राण्यसृगुक्षितानि
वीरावधूतानि तनुद्रुहाणि ।
दीप्तां प्रभां प्राजनयन्त तत्र
तपात्यये विद्युदिवान्तरिक्षे ॥

meaning.en: Weapons whetted, wet with blood, shaken off by heroes and set against their armor, gave off a blazing glow there, like lightning in the sky at the summer's end.

verses.text:
प्रकम्पितानामभिघातवेगै-
रभिघ्नतां चापततां जवेन ।
वक्त्राण्यशोभन्त तदा नराणां
वाय्वीरितानीव महाम्बुजानि ॥

meaning.en: The faces of men, shaken by the force of blows, striking and rushing in, looked beautiful then, like great lotuses stirred by the wind.

verses.text:
महावने दाव इव प्रदीप्ते
यथा प्रभा भास्करस्यापि नश्येत् ।
तथा तवासीद्ध्वजिनी प्रदीप्ता
महाभये भारत भीमरूपा ॥

meaning.en: As in a great forest set on fire the sun's light would be lost, so your army, blazing in that great fear, O Bharata, looked terrible.

verses.text:
तत्संप्रदीप्तं बलमस्मदीयं
निशाम्य पार्थास्त्वरितास्तथैव ।
सर्वेषु सैन्येषु पदातिसंघा-
नचोदयंस्तेऽथ चक्रुः प्रदीपान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing our army blazing, the Parthas too, in haste, urged on the bands of foot soldiers in all their armies, and they made torches.

verses.text:
गजे गजे सप्त कृताः प्रदीपा
रथे रथे चैव दश प्रदीपाः ।
द्वावश्वपृष्ठे परिपार्श्वतोऽन्ये
ध्वजेषु चान्ये जघनेषु चान्ये ॥

meaning.en: Seven torches on every elephant, ten on every chariot, two on each horse's back, others at the sides, others on banners, others at the rear.

verses.text:
सेनासु सर्वासु च पार्श्वतोऽन्ये
पश्चात्पुरस्ताच्च समन्ततश्च ।
मध्ये तथान्ये ज्वलिताग्निहस्ताः
सेनाद्वयेऽपि स्म नरा विचेरुः ॥

meaning.en: In all the armies others went at the sides, behind, in front and all around, and others in the middle, with burning fire in their hands; men moved about in both armies.

verses.text:
सर्वेषु सैन्येषु पदातिसंघा
व्यामिश्रिता हस्तिरथाश्ववृन्दैः ।
मध्ये तथान्ये ज्वलिताग्निहस्ता
व्यदीपयन्पाण्डुसुतस्य सेनाम् ॥

meaning.en: In all the armies the bands of foot soldiers, mixed with groups of elephants, chariots and horses, and others in the middle with blazing fire in hand, lit up the army of Pandu's son.

verses.text:
तेन प्रदीप्तेन तथा प्रदीप्तं
बलं तदासीद्बलवद्बलेन ।
भाः कुर्वता भानुमता ग्रहेण
दिवाकरेणाग्निरिवाभितप्तः ॥

meaning.en: Lit by that fire, that army, strong with strength, was lit as fire is heated by the radiant sun.

verses.text:
तयोः प्रभाः पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षं
सर्वा व्यतिक्रम्य दिशश्च वृद्धाः ।
तेन प्रकाशेन भृशं प्रकाशं
बभूव तेषां तव चैव सैन्यम् ॥

meaning.en: Their lights, rising, filled the earth, the sky and all quarters; with that light both your army and theirs became brilliantly lit.

verses.text:
तेन प्रकाशेन दिवंगमेन
संबोधिता देवगणाश्च राजन् ।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघाः
समागमन्नप्सरसश्च सर्वाः ॥

meaning.en: Awakened by that light that went up to heaven, the hosts of gods came, O king, with the groups of gandharvas, yakshas, asuras and siddhas, and all the apsarases.

verses.text:
तद्देवगन्धर्वसमाकुलं च
यक्षासुरेन्द्राप्सरसां गणैश्च ।
हतैश्च वीरैर्दिवमारुहद्भि-
रायोधनं दिव्यकल्पं बभूव ॥

meaning.en: Crowded with gods and gandharvas, with throngs of yakshas, chief asuras and apsarases, and with slain heroes rising to heaven, that battlefield became like heaven itself.

verses.text:
रथाश्वनागाकुलदीपदीप्तं
संरब्धयोधाहतविद्रुताश्वम् ।
महद्बलं व्यूढरथाश्वनागं
सुरासुरव्यूहसमं बभूव ॥

meaning.en: The great force, lit by torches amid crowded chariots, horses and elephants, with horses fleeing, struck by enraged warriors, its chariots, horses and elephants drawn up in array, was like the array of gods and asuras.

verses.text:
तच्छक्तिसंघाकुलचण्डवातं
महारथाभ्रं रथवाजिघोषम् ।
शस्त्रौघवर्षं रुधिराम्बुधारं
निशि प्रवृत्तं नरदेवयुद्धम् ॥

meaning.en: It was a battle of kings in the night, with spear-throngs as a wild wind, great warriors as clouds, the noise of chariots and horses as thunder, a rain of volleys of weapons and streams of blood as water.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्महाग्निप्रतिमो महात्मा
संतापयन्पाण्डवान्विप्रमुख्यः ।
गभस्तिभिर्मध्यगतो यथार्को
वर्षात्यये तद्वदभून्नरेन्द्र ॥

meaning.en: In it, O lord of men, that great-souled chief of brahmins (Drona), blazing like a great fire and scorching the Pandavas, stood in the middle with his rays like the sun at the end of the rains.
